curriculumAlignmentSummary: The active textbook unit covers website development (front-end vs back-end), HTML/CSS features (forms, tables, animations), JavaScript advanced programming constructs (arrays, loops, array functions), complex algorithms (searching in arrays/lists), and advanced testing/debugging techniques (unit tests, breakpoints, watchpoints). Past papers from model papers and annual exams (2022-2025) primarily target C programming, flowcharts, logic gates, and Boolean algebra for Grade 10 Computer Science under the older scheme/syllabus, meaning most web development and JS concepts from this active unit have no direct observed form in the supplied past papers.
